strings.counts.cover: the counts cover every deal in the stated window
strings.counts.not_recomputed: the holder's statement under the holder key, not recomputed
strings.deals.undecided: counted deals not decided: a row not yet final, not reached, in disagreement or dispute, or without the statement it needed
strings.deals.unpriced: counted deals without a recorded amount, in no value band
strings.deals.local_times: counted deals with a row that rests on a record no witness timed, or with no witnessed time at all
strings.deals.remedied: of the deals that did not hold, those whose unmet rows the holder remedied
strings.deals.not_honoured: of the deals that did not hold, those where the holder did not honour a ruling
strings.coverage.start: complete from {coverage_start}; before it, the deals the holder carried into its shelf log
strings.level.recomputed: recounted from the holder's whole shelf
strings.anchor.unwitnessed: unwitnessed: no witness receipt for this snapshot
strings.anchor.witnessed_only: the witness timed this snapshot, not the records the counts rest on
strings.deals.shop_preauth: counted deals that were shop purchases paid up front
